item.title: Rainy weather slams roadways as deadline looms to expedite ODOT gas tax vote
item.description: Oregon transportation workers are working to keep roads safe during the rainy weather while awaiting approval for more funding, as a bill to speed up funding for ODOT makes its way to the House.
